description: Grabs a single analysis window from an .ana file at the given time - a one-window spectral snapshot (about 2.9 ms; sfprops reports 0.002907 s for a default 44.1 kHz analysis). The output is a valid but degenerate .ana whose purpose is to feed other spectral tools, above all morph glide (verified end-to-end: two grabbed windows -> morph glide -> a 2.0 s interpolation .ana); pvoc synth of a bare grabbed window produces a ZERO-frame wav (verified), so never audition a grab directly. Times past the true end of the analysis grab the last window (grab at 2.5 on a 2.03 s analysis is data-identical to grab at 2.0), but CDP still range-checks against an internal bound slightly past the end ('out of range (0.000000 to 3.025941)' on that same file). Deterministic (analysis data identical across runs; only the RIFF LIST date chunk differs).
musical_use: The freeze-frame primitive of the morph glide workflow: grab one window from sound A and one from sound B, then morph glide interpolates a seamless spectral glide between the two snapshots over any duration - instant drones, risers and slow timbral crossfades built from single instants. Grab at spectrally distinctive moments (a vowel peak, a cymbal's shimmer, the densest point of a texture - use analyze()'s trajectory to find them). spec magnify does grab-plus-stretch in one step when only one sound is involved; grab is the two-sound door. A grabbed window is also the cheapest way to freeze a timbre for spectral 'chords': glide between two grabs of the SAME file for subtle internal motion.

time.description: Time of the window to grab. CDP enforces 0 to slightly past the analysed duration (input-dependent; refusal on a 2.03 s analysis quoted '(0.000000 to 3.025941)'); anything past the last window inside that bound grabs the last window (verified data-identical). Negative refused. Breakpoint file refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

examples.description: Freeze the one-second mark of a sound as a spectral snapshot.
examples.expected_use: A one-window .ana (~2.9 ms) for morph glide; do not synth it directly.

examples.description: Grab the sound's opening spectrum for a glide from its own attack.
examples.expected_use: Pair with a later grab and morph glide between them.

known_issues: The output is ONE analysis window (~0.0029 s; duration model is that constant, exact to 0.24% against the measured 0.002907 s). It is scaffolding for morph glide / spec magnify, not audible material: pvoc synth of a grabbed window yields a 0-frame wav (verified, exit 0).

DIVERGENCE (softened): the banner says 'A time beyond end of file will grab last window' - true only within CDP's internal bound slightly past the end; far beyond it refuses with a range error ('Parameter[1] Value (99.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 3.025941)' on a 2.03 s analysis).
time rejects breakpoint files ('brkpnt_files not permitted').
Two runs differ byte-wise only in the RIFF LIST date-comment chunk; the analysis data chunk is identical (deterministic).
The one-window duration is analysis-settings-dependent (default engine PVOC: 0.002907 s at 44.1 kHz); non-default analyses would change the constant.
